messages:
Anna Li: Thanks all — quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A about customer wins/losses. I want to capture the asks we heard and a few clarifying questions for leadership.

Mike Larson: TL;DR from sales: we won two infra-heavy startups because of latency guarantees + simple SDK. We lost a large regulated prospect because of private KMS + on-prem gap.

Dina Rozario: Add: another loss was due to perf variance on long-context streaming — they ran a burst and tail latency spiked. We should call that out separately from security concerns.

Sanjay Patel: @Anna thanks — two clarifying Qs: 1) For the private KMS ask, is the ask purely KMS-in-VPC or full HSM/SOC2 box? 2) For the perf variance, do we have reproducible traces/steps?

Anna Li: Good questions. From the deal review: they wanted customer-managed keys in their VPC (bring-your-own KMS) + audit logs shipped to their SIEM. HSM was a bonus but not mandatory. For perf, they ran many concurrent streaming sessions with long prefix caching disabled.

Eve Chen: Note from customer success: the win we kept hearing was "we trusted Redwood on burst stability" — demoed 10k concurrent streams with <150ms p95 in us-west. That line was in 3 RFPs.

Mike Larson: Top asks surfaced across accounts: "private KMS in VPC", "granular RBAC & enterprise audit", "better docs/examples for canary rollouts", and "custom quantization / model tuning support".

Dina Rozario: Also: customers keep asking for an automated eval hook in Console that ties prompt regressions to deployments (so they can block rollouts).

Sanjay Patel: Leadership question: can we commit to priority of these items? Which are "must-have" for next quarter vs backlog? My recommendation: 1) Private KMS in VPC (Q1 priority), 2) RBAC + Audit (Q1), 3) Canary rollout UX (Q2), 4) Custom quantization tooling (Q2/Q3).

Anna Li: @Sanjay that aligns with Exec notes. Can we get a one-paragraph blurb from Eng/Platform for the next all-hands to set expectations? Something like: "We're shipping VPC KMS support in Q1 with audit log export; RBAC improvements rolling in the same window".

Sanjay Patel: I can draft that — quick ask to Eng: what are the blockers for VPC/KMS? From runtime side I think it's key wrapping + secure key access proxies. @deploy-bot any infra notes?

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: there are 2 infra tickets blocking private KMS rollout: #INF-442 (KMS proxy auth) and #INF-487 (audit-log delivery). Both in triage.

Eve Chen: Customer-facing note: Sales & CS want a short FAQ we can hand out that explains "what we support today" vs "on our roadmap". Short one-pager helps close deals while we ship.

Dina Rozario: Action items I captured: 1) Sanjay draft all-hands blurb, 2) Eng/Infra reply with blockers + ETA by EOD Thu, 3) PM/doc team draft one-pager for Sales/CS, 4) Ops create a small repro for streaming-tail-latency and share traces.

Mike Larson: Can we add a quick wins list for next two weeks? e.g., publish recommended canary config, add an example for prefix caching in SDK, ship streaming best-practices doc.

Anna Li: Love it — last ask for leadership: please confirm priority order and whether we should route more headcount to infra or product to hit the Q1 items.

Sanjay Patel: I'll confirm headcount asks by EOD Friday. If anyone has specific customer quotes to include in the blurb/FAQ, drop them in this thread.

Eve Chen: Dropping one quote: "Redwood's burst stability kept our product online during demo week — that convinced leadership." — happy to anonymize.

Anna Li: Thanks everyone. I'll synthesize and post a short summary + action-tracking doc in #product after we get the Eng blockers.

Mike Larson: :thumbsup:

Dina Rozario: 
"/note: repro steps for streaming tail will be attached once Ops uploads to S3 — link to follow"

Sanjay Patel: End of thread for now — will update with blurb + headcount decision.
